c74object.name: lp.bernie
c74object.description: lp.bernie counts the successes in n trials with probability p each (binomial distribution); with n = 1 it is a binary choice.

objarg.name: seed
objarg.digest: Seed for the random number generator (0, the default, seeds automatically)

method.name: float
method.digest: In the 3rd inlet: p: probability of 1 resulting
